title: Home Fries with Peppers and Onions
changes_from_base: Red and green peppers charred with the onion and folded back in; optional cayenne; a little more oil and salt.
summary: This version follows the diner-style home fries method, but the onion is cooked together with red and green peppers until charred, folded back in at the end with a touch of optional cayenne, a little extra oil and salt.
equipment: large heavy frying pan (30 cm), cast iron if possible

ingredients.item: all-purpose or waxy potatoes (such as Yukon Gold), scrubbed and cut into 1.5 cm cubes
fine sea salt or table salt, for the water
medium onion, cut into 2 cm pieces
red pepper, cut into 2 cm pieces
green pepper, cut into 2 cm pieces
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Char the peppers and onion
steps.text: Heat 1½ tbsp of the oil in the frying pan over medium-high and cook the onion and both peppers together for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and charred at the edges. Tip them into a bowl; cooking them apart from the potatoes keeps their moisture from getting in the way of the potatoes crisping later.

steps.title: Parboil the potatoes
steps.text: Cover the potato cubes with 1 cm of cold water in a saucepan, add the salt and bring just to the boil. Drain at once and leave to steam-dry for 2 minutes, following the same par-cook as the classic diner-style home fries, so the inside cooks through before the crust forms in the pan.

steps.title: Fry until crisp
steps.text: Heat the remaining oil and the butter in the pan over medium-high, add the potatoes in a single layer, and fry for 12-15 minutes in total, turning every 4-5 minutes, until crisp and golden all over. Keeping the pieces in one layer early on gives each side proper contact with the hot pan.

steps.title: Return the vegetables
steps.text: Tip the charred peppers and onion back into the pan with the paprika, cayenne (if using), salt and pepper. Toss everything together over the heat for 1-2 minutes until warmed through and the spices smell fragrant.

steps.title: Serve straight away
steps.text: Serve the home fries hot from the pan while the crust is at its crispest. The peppers add colour and a touch of sweetness against the smoky paprika and optional cayenne heat.

tips: Cut the peppers and onion to a similar 2 cm size so they char at the same rate.
A common mistake is cooking the peppers alongside the potatoes from the start - their moisture steams the potatoes and stops them crisping, so fry them separately first.
Leave out the cayenne entirely for a milder dish; it's optional for a reason.
Use a thin metal spatula to turn the potatoes without knocking off the crust.
storage: Keep in the fridge for up to 2 days in an airtight container; freezing isn't recommended, as the peppers and potatoes turn soft on thawing. Reheat in a hot pan until piping hot (74°C) to refresh the crisp edges. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
